The `tcp_chat` repository implements a command-line chat system built around a line protocol defined in `protocol.py::frame` for handling commands and length-prefixed frames. The network architecture consists of a threaded TCP chat server in `server.py::run` that manages one thread per client, enforces unique nicknames, and broadcasts messages across connected users. Clients interact with the system using the command-line interface provided in `client.py::main`. The project includes test coverage using pytest to verify its modules.
